content:
Upscaled Mekanism 32x 是一款 [Faithful](https://faithfulpack.net/)\-風格的資源包，為 [Applied Energistics 2]([https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/applied-energistics-2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2)) 模組提供更高解析度的紋理。它在保留原始風格的同時提升視覺清晰度，呈現更銳利、更細緻的 32×32 畫面。


![](https://imgur.com/Mbh5hMm.png) ![](https://imgur.com/39AZY5w.png)


### **附加模組支援** * AE Infinity Booster * AE2: Crafting Tree * AE2 Import Export Card * AE2 Network Analyser * Applied Energistics 2 Wireless Terminals * Applied Flux * Applied Mekanistics * Ars Énergistique * ME Requester * Mega Cells

### **致謝** * [Improved Applied Energistics 2](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/improved-applied-energistics-2) - 本資源包的部分紋理設計參考了 Improved AE2 資源包 * [Faithful 32x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/faithful-32x) - 本資源包的部分紋理設計參考了 Faithful 32x
